---
name: New reference architecture
about: Propose a new architecture, decision guide, or pattern before writing it up
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: proposal
---

**Problem this solves** — one or two sentences, concrete, not a feature wishlist.

**Where it fits** — new `docs/architectures/`, `docs/decision-guides/`, or `docs/patterns/` entry?

**What makes this a real pattern, not a one-off** — have you (or can you cite someone who has) actually hit this problem more than once?

**Sources you'd draw on** — real, checkable references only (SAP Help Portal, SAP Community, vendor docs, your own experience). No fabricated citations.
